gloss: to judge (the right moment); to choose with judgment

definitions.gloss: to judge the right moment; to time; to choose with good judgment
definitions.explanation: To watch a situation and judge when, or what, is best, then act on it. The object is most often a time: タイミング, {頃合|ころあ}い, {時期|じき}. Less often it is goods chosen on someone else's behalf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頃合|ころあ}い→頃合い：14688_koroai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らう。
⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らって⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけた。
examples.english: I picked my moment and spoke to her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{時|とき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らって、⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I waited until my boss was in a good mood and asked about taking time off.

notes:
Typically appears as 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らって, followed by the action done at the chosen moment. In requests it leaves the choice to the listener: ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見計|みはか}らって⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please use your judgment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らう: to time something well
- ⟦{頃合|ころあ}い→頃合い：14688_koroai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らう: to wait for the right moment
- ⟦{隙|すき}→隙：10999_suki_gap⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らう: to watch for an opening
- ⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見計|みはか}らう: to choose the right time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見極|みきわ}める→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧: to ascertain — judging what something truly is, not when to act
- ⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to aim at — stresses the target, not the patient waiting
